'''Javlin''', or '''Jav''', was a [[Besalisk/Legends|Besalisk]] [[Pilot/Legends|Pilot]] who served aboard a [[Freighter/Legends|Freighter]] with [[Chalan Talosi/Legends|Chalan Talosi]] and [[WAC-77/Legends|WAC-77]].<ref name="Special Mods" />

==Behind the scenes==
Javlin appears in the opening story in [[Fantasy Flight Games]]' [[2016]] [[roleplaying game]] sourcebook ''[[Special Modifications]]''.<ref name="Special Mods" />
